result.title: How to Manage Your Workspace With ChatGPT Work
result.description: See how the ChatGPT admin plugin brings workspace administration into ChatGPT Work. Aarti Bagul, Member of GTM Staff at OpenAI, demonstrates how admins can analyze adoption and credit usage, update and share an AI rollout deck, and review and approve usage limit requests without switching between tools.

result.title: Build agent-ready sites with WebMCP
result.description: Eric Provencher from OpenAI Developer Experience demonstrates WebMCP support in Codex with Codex Modeling Studio, a 3D modeling site designed for people and agents to use together. See how adding tools directly to a website lets Codex discover capabilities, iterate on visuals, capture feedback, and collaborate through the same interface.

result.title: Make information visual with ChatGPT
result.description: Turn dense information into interactive visualizations with the Visualize skill in ChatGPT and Codex. Katia Gil Guzman shows how to transform meeting notes into an interface, iterate with calendar views and actions, and export the result as an image or publish it as a site.
